language_task: Pick up the spoon and place it into the box.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially rests on the table beside the blue box (frame 0, ceiling). The robot grasps and lifts it clear of the table (frames 44–48, wrist_left and wrist_right), transports it over the box, and opens the gripper to release it inside (frames 72–76, wrist_right). The spoon remains in the box after the robot withdraws (frames 89–95, ceiling). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
